avis.titre: So far so good, on my extra sensitive skin.
avis.texte: This is easy to apply around my eyes, & on my throat. It also mixes well with moisturizer and tinted cream. It does NOT irritate my very very sensitive skin. I get a rash from hugging people & even seem to be allergic to my own tears, 😂 Lol. I have a that trade mark, auto-immune disease, Lupus, butterfly shaped red discoloration in my nose and cheeks, and this does NOT make this it brighter, most serums do. So, far i get good hydration from this, with-out the weird wrinkle plumping, of other "wrinkle" products. I have been looking for a replacement for the Loreal' double lifting, the one that was one side white moisturizer and one side red gel. The lifting, with it, was a instant, and noticeable all over tightening. It is no longer available. I tried a comparatively expensive "Rock" product, and with the very 1st, tiny dab, it raised the laugh line on the right side of my mouth & lightened it, in comparison to the other side. This weird, puffy, white, remained, and it would seem to be permanent. I am very light skinned, of mixed race, African American (Ghana region), and White(Irish & Polish). In my youth, I was golden in summer, with warm, yellow under tones the rest of a year. Now, health, age, medication & lack of sunlight all factors; my face is pale & red even as compared to all but the fairest Caucasian's. So, i am unable to wear any foundation or concealer to darken the bizarre white line, that i hope isn't as noticeable to others, as it is to me. After this experienc

I had such high hopes for this, but it literally did nothing for my fine lines in 1 hour, and if I use too much, it pills like crazy, looking like rough texture and flakes off. I mean, maybe my fine lines are TOO fine to see quick results, because so far, NOTHING has worked (cheap stuff, expensive stuff, drug store brands, high-end brands, K-beauty or European products...nothing). So, I'm going to give it the benefit of a doubt because my fine lines seem to be fairly stubborn and I feel like this is why so many women my age (41) get plastic surgery or cosmetic medical procedures. I'm going to keep using it to see if there are long term results, but only at night and only a few drops to targeted areas, so this will last me a VERY long time. I gave it three stars because in the last three days that I've been using it, it hasn't caused any break-outs or irritation, and that's a huge relief. That said... I have to add that I am actually impressed with this line's moisturizer, though! That is a holy grail product for oily/combination skin, because it's plush and feels super luxe and expensive, but it's cheaper than the brand I've been using, and soft and absorbs quickly, but doesn't leave me oily or cause any break-outs, and it smells DEVINE, but they do offer an unscented version. So, even though this particular product I'm reviewing isn't for me, credit where credit is due: I highly recommend the Revitalift moisturizer (not this serum, but the cream that comes in a jar/pot)! avis.titre: Good for Dehydrate fine linesGood for Dehydrate fine lines
avis.texte: I have dehydrated skin and some fine lines on my forehead, and I’m 25 years old. I used the entire bottle of this serum before writing my review. At first, I honestly didn’t notice much difference and thought it might not work for me. But as I kept using it consistently, especially toward the end of the bottle, I started seeing real results. My skin feels more hydrated and my forehead lines look softer. I can now say that it really does work, but it takes time and consistency to see the results. The only downside for me is the price. It’s a bit expensive, which makes me unsure if I would purchase it again even though it worked well. Overall, if you have dehydrated skin and are looking for something to help with hydration and fine lines, this serum is worth trying

avis.titre: Deep hydration and much softer skin: my favorite serum!
avis.texte: What I liked most: • Immediate absorption: It features a lightweight gel texture that instantly melts into the skin. It leaves no sticky residue, making it ideal for use before my moisturizer or makeup. • Plumping effect: I’ve noticed that my skin feels much more elastic and "juicy" right from the very first application. It visibly helps to smooth out fine lines caused by dehydration. • No strong fragrance: I love that it doesn't have a heavy scent, making it perfect if you have slightly sensitive skin or simply prefer products with neutral aromas. Things to keep in mind: • Application: The best trick I’ve learned is to apply it to slightly damp skin (after washing my face or using a toner). I feel that this way, the hyaluronic acid "traps" moisture more effectively, and the results are twice as potent. Final verdict: This is a high-quality serum at a very affordable price point. If you’re looking for real hydration that makes a noticeable difference in your skin's texture, this Revitalift product won't let you down. It has become a staple in my bathroom!

Excellent quality for the price, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to boost their skincare routine.

avis.titre: APPLY ONLY TO DAMP, MOIST SKIN FOR BEST RESULTS!
avis.texte: I have dry mature skin, and moisture is the key to a youthful texture and tone to ones skin. I believe in serums as I’ve used them for years. I highly recommend this serum! After reading some reviews it is noted that the product leaves skin dry and tight feeling, also that it may have a “peeling” property. I do know that with any serum one must apply sparingly to moist and damp skin for optimal absorption and results. Preferably after a gentle wash. Allow the product to be absorbed entirely (even dry) THEN apply a light moisturizer made for your skin type. I would be willing to bet that this serum doesn’t work well with SPF, so if you’re protecting in the day try using this serum at night under other serums and night creams without SPF. Used correctly you too can get some pretty amazing results!😉

I have never had much of a skin care routine other than daily washing and occasionally exfoliating, however, now that I am in my 40's my face and eyes started looking very dry and dull. (I also live in Las Vegas where it is very dry, so that doesn't help). I didn't want to spend a fortune and was overwhelmed by all the options, however this Revitalift hyaluronic acid serum had great reviews and the price was really good so I started with this "trial size" bottle and the L'Oreal collagen moisturizer. Immediately my skin looked and felt so much better! I have been using this twice daily for 2 months now (I still have a bit under a 1/4 left in my bottle) and I am very pleased with the results. My skin is more firm and has more color. My skin is so much softer and smoother now - like the fresh after exfoliating smooth! The wrinkles on my forhead and around my eyes are much finer now and with a resting face they aren't even visible anymore! It takes very little so the bottle lasts a good amount of time especially for the price. It is easy to apply the desired amount of drops and it absorbs quickly. I dont know how the pricer brands work but I couldn't imagine any better results than I've gotten from this! This is now part of my daily routine as I love how my face looks and feels! I highly recommend this product. ***Remember to shop around! This item is much cheaper (currently) at Wal-Mart***

I was so disappointed to think L’Oréal lowered their (and my) standards on this serum. So I went to my fridge to take a picture of my outlet, even showing you the applicator rather than a dropper. And then I was going to look for a different brand. But I was going to save the applicator! It’s perfect. THATS when I saw the difference , thank God. And it’s still L’Oréal! It’s Revitalift. . RevitaLIFT. It’s 2.5% Hyalauronic Acic + Caffeine. It’s the caffeine combined w the HA that gives me the result I’m looking for everyday., For all of you ladies that were disappointed in the this product, don’t give up…. Just switch! I’ve been using this for a few years and I think it’s the best eye serum out there. I keep mine in the fridge. (Which is why the serum looks cloudy. I took it out 5 mins ago.) The applicator is a wand with 3 rotating metal balls, that not only apply the serum smoothly and evenly, but the caffeine and the cold serum, cut down on puffiness. Not to mention it feels great esp. in the morning!! And again, I’m not getting paid, and I’m not an influencer. avis.titre: Helps dry face, but seems a little oily until it dries down for me
avis.texte: This Hyaluronic Acid Serum has seemed to help a little bit with my dry facial skin but I can’t tell if it is also making me break out a little bit. After applying my face gets a little red and it looks like my skin is oily until it really dries down (I put it on only after taking a shower and washing my face). After a few days of using the serum it seemed like up near my hair line on my forehead had been breaking out more than usual and down in my chin area. I can’t tell for certain if it’s the serum doing it or not but I do know the rest of my face seems to benefit from using the serum. I like the glass dropper and style of the bottle. You only need a dropper full or so to cover your face so it’ll definitely last you long enough with every day use.

avis.titre: Seems overpriced for only 1.5% hyaluronic acid
avis.texte: I have been using the Amara Organics Vitamin C Serum for Face 20% with Hyaluronic Acid & Vitamin E, 1 fl. oz for $17.05, it is 99% natural and 72% organic ingredients. The L’Oreal Paris Revitalift Derm Intensives Hyaluronic Acid 1.5% Serum comes in a big clear bottle that’s mostly glass, however it’s also 1oz and retails for $23.99. Seems a bit expensive for only 1.5% Hyaluronic Acid, has water, glycerin, castor oil among other ingredients. I am not particularly a fan of using castor oil on my face.

We can all agree that this is a fantastic serum. The only reason I give it four stars instead of 5 stars is that $40 is quite a bit to pay. Yes, it is a 50 ml container. That's more than many of these serum facial products. You're supposed to apply two to three drops to a clean dry skin every morning before you put the moisturizer. You should have void the eye area. I hope the photos are helpful of giving an idea of how big it is. If they could reduce the price to $30, I would give it 5 stars.

avis.titre: This is only a 1.5% hyaluronic acid, nothing more.
avis.texte: Folks, the only active ingredient in this is merely a 1.5% hyaluronic acid solution. That being said; good product, however The Ordinary has a 2% hyaluronic acid solution for just over $6. Same darn thing only considerably less expensive. Do yourself and your wallet a favor and look into it.

avis.titre: Very good serum; similar to more expensive brands. Quality glass bottle and dropper.
avis.texte: I really liked this serum a lot. I use a very similar serum, different brand with more than double the price point of this L'Oreal hyaluronic serum, and this is a very impressive product. Only a couple drops are needed, it flows smoothly onto the skin and absorbs immediately. The ingredients in this serum are very good ingredients that I do believe improves the look of the skin. I really appreciate that this product is fragrance and dye free. This is a facial serum, however, it also really improves the look of the back of the hands, definitely anti-aging and moisturizing. As to it's effectiveness in reducing wrinkles and plumping the skin, to be fair I was previously using a similar serum so I wasn't using this from a zero point comparison. HOWEVER - that said, using only this L'Oreal serum for two weeks my face does look fresh and nice, and there's a noticeable improvement in the skin on the back of my hands where I apply a couple drops as well. A little bit goes a long way - One bottle will last quite awhile. The packaging is nice and the bottle is glass with a good quality dropper. The instructions state results will be seen after using 2xday/2weeks. I've used it now for two weeks, 2xday, and have had no issues with irritation etc. I definitely recommend this serum from L'Oreal!

This photo shows before and after for one week of using this product. At first I didn’t notice a difference except redness on my cheeks in the morning. Today as I was putting on my makeup I noticed the mirror looked airbrushed. So I decided to do a one week contrast and my jaw hit the floor. I can’t believe this drugstore serum outperformed a two hundred dollar high end product. I wish I had started using this 20 years ago! I only use it at night after I clean and tone. All of my other products remained the same. I’ve had to deal with these ice pick scars for decades. Just amazing.

Hey all, I wanted to share my tip - if you wanna see extra incredible results and transform this serum into one 5 times the price - add essential oils, specifically frankincense and lavender! Add maybe a dash of pomegranate or coconut oil, and voila! You got yourself some miracle juice! I'm in my 50's, been mixing natural oils and such into my serums for years.. it works!
This product is designed to address the signs of aging. It's clear colored, feels a bit thicky and does not irritate the skin.
Love this product! It’s lightweight and not greasy!! I started using it 2 months before my wedding and haven’t stopped!!!

I like this serum because it doesn't dry my skin out. I use a couple of drops twice a day along with my moisturizer. The product says its safe for sensitive skin but I'm beginning to doubt its for sensitive skin. My neck looks blotchy and red as you can see in the picture. I will give it another week,use it once a day maybe and see if it'll make a difference.

The product feels great on skin. It has no smell and not sticky at all. I have noticed that this is product is providing evenness in skin.. it has reduced some visible unevenness. I will continue to use it and update if I see further difference.
